data.current_description:
Looks up up to 100 cadastreIds in one call and returns whichever properties resolve, plus a notFound list for the rest. Each requested id counts as one call against the property:read quota, whether or not it resolves. Idempotency-Key replays the same response to a retried request for 24 hours. A 404 means the country's cadastre register itself is not served; an individual id that does not resolve within a served register comes back in notFound, not as a 404.
